description: Implementation of WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class responsible for creating various WebAudio player tasks such as play, pause, stop, shutdown, set caps, set volume, write buffer, handle bus message, and EOS within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WebAudio player tasks such as play, pause, stop, shutdown, set caps, set volume, write buffer, handle bus message, and EOS.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a Shutdown task for the WebAudio player.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a Stop task for the WebAudio player.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a Play task for the WebAudio player.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a Pause task for the WebAudio player.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates an End of Stream (EOS) task.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a SetCaps task to configure audio format.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a SetVolume task to adjust volume.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a WriteBuffer task to write audio data.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a HandleBusMessage task to process bus messages.
